zh-CN.name: 财务看板
zh-CN.description: 围绕收入、费用、现金流或其他财务指标组织的看板。它描述数据与工作任务，不代表投资建议；每个数字需要币种、时间范围和会计或业务口径。
use_when: 使用者需要比较财务指标或追踪预算差异。
数据口径、访问权限与时间范围能够明确。
avoid_when: 不能混合不同币种而不说明换算。
不应把未结算、预测或缺失数字伪装为实绩。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
围绕任务分组展示收入、支出和现金流，明确币种、周期、单位和口径；将预算、实绩与预测区分开，负值与异常除颜色外还有文字提示；保留数据来源与访问权限说明。
专属演示：样例收入、支出与结余的现金流分解，货币单位同步用于全部数字和图表。 参数：样例货币单位 {currency}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Financial Dashboard
en.description: A dashboard organized around financial measures such as revenue, expenses or cash flow. It describes data and work tasks rather than investment advice; values require currency, period and accounting or business definitions.
use_when: Users need to compare financial measures or track budget variance.
Definitions, permissions and reporting periods can be made explicit.
avoid_when: Do not combine currencies without explaining conversion.
Do not present unsettled, forecast or missing values as actual results.
en.prompt_template:
Group revenue, expenses and cash flow by the task, showing currency, period, units and definitions. Separate budgets, actual results and forecasts. Use textual cues as well as color for negative values and exceptions, and explain provenance and access permissions.
Dedicated demonstration: Sample income, expense and balance decomposition; the chosen currency applies to every number and chart. Parameters: sample currency {currency}; content gap {gap_px}px.
